report_framework_description: Defense Information Systems Agency Security Technical Implementation Guides

report_controls.control_title: The audit package must be installed
The auditd service must be enabled and running
A firewall must be enabled and active
Restrict exposed kernel pointer addresses access
Restrict access to the kernel message buffer
Restrict usage of ptrace to descendant processes
Enforce DAC on hardlinks and symlinks
Use reverse path filtering on all IPv4 interfaces
Do not accept source-routed IPv4 packets
SELinux must be in enforcing mode
RHEL 8 passwords must have a minimum of 15 characters
RHEL 8 must enforce password complexity by requiring at least one numeric character
RHEL 8 must enforce password complexity by requiring at least one uppercase character
RHEL 8 must enforce password complexity by requiring at least one lowercase character
RHEL 8 must enforce password complexity by requiring at least one special character
RHEL 8 passwords must not contain more than three consecutive repeating characters
RHEL 8 user account passwords must have a 60-day maximum password lifetime restriction
RHEL 8 passwords for new users must have a minimum of 24 hours between password changes
RHEL 8 must automatically lock an account when three unsuccessful logon attempts occur

The RHEL 8 SSH server must be configured to use only DOD-approved encryption ciphers employing FIPS 140-3-validated cryptographic hash algorithms to protect the confidentiality of SSH server connections.

The RHEL 8 SSH server must be configured to use only Message Authentication Codes (MACs) employing FIPS 140-3-validated cryptographic hash algorithms to protect the confidentiality of SSH server connections.
